steps.name: Parse
steps.detail: Read both CSVs with UTF-8 BOM handling and parse UTC timestamps.

steps.name: Validate
steps.detail: Count missing cells, duplicate keys, invalid country codes, and hourly gaps.

steps.name: Canonicalize
steps.detail: Map each interconnector to sorted endpoint ID and keep raw aliases for audit.

steps.name: Align
steps.detail: Retain the common recent history and align country features by hourly timestamp.

steps.name: Scale
steps.detail: Fit feature and target mean/std only on the training window, then apply to validation and test.

steps.name: Split
steps.detail: Use the final 168 hours as a chronological holdout; no random shuffle crosses the split.

steps.name: Evaluate
steps.detail: Compare classical baselines, Fusion GRU, and DCRNN on the same target and holdout.

threshold_rule: absolute net-flow magnitude at the 75th and 90th training quantiles
